0022600030.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-6, on a three-game losing streak) host the Toronto Raptors (4-3, on a one-game winning streak) in the Bucks' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, a regular-season Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Milwaukee has gone 1-3 at home and 0-3 on the road and sits 14th in the East and fifth in the Central, five games back, while Toronto is fourth in the East and third in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back. Kam Jones is out for the Bucks with an ankle injury, and Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for the Raptors; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series Milwaukee lost 1-3, including a 122-94 loss at home on February 22, 2026.
